g.text: Aliases: reportUI = ReportPanel in UsedCarGUI / WorkspaceUI; worker = SwingWorker<ReportEvaluation,Void>; reportCmd = GenerateReportCommand; facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade.

session = EvaluationSession; agent = UsedCarAgent; tools = ToolManager; costTool = CostCalculatorTool; checker = DataQualityChecker; knowledgeTool = VehicleKnowledgeTool; repository = VehicleKnowledgeRepository.
constraintTool = ConstraintCheckerTool; factory = EvaluationStrategyFactory; policy = EvaluationStrategy (Balanced / BudgetFocused / ReliabilityFocused); planner = ChecklistPlanner.
prompt = PromptBuilder; llm = GeminiAdapter via LLMClient; parser = ResponseParser; narrative = ReportNarrativeValidator. Filled arrows = calls; open = event/schedule; dashed = returns.
Parser first checks category/evidence sets/costs, then narrative history assertions,
then prohibited numeric/condition prose and buyer-constraint contradictions.
Accepted report → AI_SUCCESS envelope → B1, then B3 cache/display.
No RiskAgeValidator / RiskGroundingValidator rerun is invented here.
sd A4 — one F12 request; exceptions transfer to B1, never retry
[true] build prompt/schema and run A4; risk may still be UNAVAILABLE.
[false] evidence.insufficient() → INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; no AI call → B1.
If planning fails: rebuild with null knowledge and add an explicit limitation.
Construct ReportEvidence(deterministic, assumptions, risk, riskStatus, inspection,
clarificationHistory, unresolvedConflicts, referenceYear); allocate generation UUID.
inspection: InspectionChecklist [local; no F10 Gemini call]
Matching clarification Vehicle → retain history and pending CONFLICT descriptions.
Otherwise history is empty. History is session-only; known conflicts block sufficiency.
[otherwise] risk=null; explicit UNAVAILABLE. No implicit F08 request.
Reuse RiskAssessment category; prior explanatory prose is not verified evidence.
alt saved F08 eligibility [exact predicate in verification document]
sd A3 — current prior risk, local inspection and ReportEvidence
collectEvidence returns RiskEvidence(v,p,m,k,violations,c,guidance,limitations,constraintsAvailable,referenceYear). Then withListingNeeds augments uncertainty.
policy: EvaluationStrategy [manual mode reuses chosen policy]
A saved cost is reused; otherwise compute only with supplied assumptions. Failure leaves cost unavailable.
Missing fuel consumption / tax / allowances remain unavailable, not zero. No invented cost assumptions.
Constraints: budget/mileage/transmission/accident tolerance; no body-type match. Strategy guides prose, not calculations.
sd A2 — generateRecommendation: optional cost first, then collectEvidence; Java owns all facts
No unsaved form fields; no cached F10 checklist is read for report generation.
ref A2 → A3 → A4: agent.generateRecommendation(saved inputs)
GUI precheck: no saved Vehicle → show error; do not schedule.
Facade also rejects missing Vehicle or an unexpected explicit Vehicle.
Vehicle is captured before beginReport; then profile/cost/assumptions/risk/clarification/listingNeeds.
New revision clears the prior report and marks generation busy.
beginReport() → revision [saved Vehicle required; not busy]
sd A1 — explicit report generation; GUI worker or synchronous CLI report
UML-08A — Current Java evidence and validated Gemini recommendation | F12 / UC12 / SD06 | 48fe916 | A1 → A2 → A3 → A4 → B1
Figure 3.8 — SD06: Personalized Recommendation and Final Evaluation Report
